name: book-exchange
description: Bookswap — a web app for exchanging books between readers

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix server && npm run format:check --prefix client
